evd_title: Removing the knowledge-guided module from the novelty prediction model dropped accuracy from 0.84 to 0.74
finding: Removing the knowledge-guided module from the novelty prediction model dropped accuracy from 0.84 to 0.74
P: 2,432 ICLR 2022 papers, binary method novelty; same held-out test split (~244)
I: Ours-SciBERT (fine-tuned SciBERT knowledge fusion, HK + ChatGPT gpt-3.5-turbo LLMK inputs)
C: Ablations: w/o knowledge-guided module, w/o SAR, w/o self-attention; SciBERT PLM baseline (F1 0.73)
O: Weighted F1/Acc: full 0.83/0.84; w/o knowledge-guided 0.73/0.74; w/o SAR 0.79/0.80; w/o self-attention 0.81/0.82
